description: This file defines an event subscriber class 'ExceptionSubscriber' that listens for exception events in a Symfony-based PHP application, handling and customizing the HTTP response for exceptions.

classes.name: ExceptionSubscriber
classes.description: An event subscriber class that listens for exception events in the Symfony framework and sets an appropriate HTTP response based on the exception type.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns an array of events this subscriber listens to, specifically the kernel's exception event with a priority of -65.

methods.name: onExceptionEvent
methods.description: Handles the exception event by setting an HTTP response, adjusting status code and headers if the exception is an HTTP exception.
